title: ewa-euro-2003-world-heavyweight
label: Damien Black

won.source: The debut pay-per-view's own results line: "The Winner of this match AND the tournament, the FIRST EVER EWA World heavyweight Champion.... 'Innovator' Damien Black!!!"

how: Won an eight-man tournament final by pinning "Crippler" Evan Crowley with the Fade to Black, becoming the first EWA World Heavyweight Champion.
note: Still champion as of the last dated document in the surviving record, 28 October 2003, when a title challenge from Johnny Lambert was broken up before it could begin.

title: ewa-euro-2003-intercontinental
label: Tommy Starr

won.source: Redemption's own results line: "The winner of this bout... a NEW EWA Intercontinental Champion.... Tommy Starr!"

how: Pinned "Crippler" Evan Crowley with the Starr Struck to win the EWA Intercontinental Championship at Redemption; the title's own history in the four weeks between its creation and this match is not part of the surviving record.
note: Retained the title against The Shit two days later, 28 October 2003, the last dated document in the surviving record.
